new_statements.quote: 两音节连读会发生变调，有比较严整的变调规律： # 基本原则：两字连读，前变后不变，也没有明显的轻声 # 前字阴平变阳平 # 前字阳平的不变 # 前字阴上也变阳平 # 前字阳上变阴上 # 前字去声多不变，有少数古浊声母去声字变高平调(55)或上声 # 前字入声的变高平(55)
new_statements.translation: When two syllables are read together tone sandhi occurs, with fairly strict rules: Basic principle: in a two-syllable string the first syllable changes and the second does not, and there is also no clear neutral tone (qingsheng). First-syllable yinping becomes yangping; first-syllable yangping does not change; first-syllable yinshang also becomes yangping; first-syllable yangshang becomes yinshang; first-syllable qusheng mostly does not change, though a few qusheng words with historically voiced initials become high level (55) or shangsheng; first-syllable rusheng becomes high level (55).
new_statements.citation: zh.wikipedia, article 永安话, section 變調 (retrieved 2026-09-17 via the MediaWiki API); the article's reference list names 周長楫、林寳卿 1992 《永安方言》 (廈門大學出版社) and 陈章太、李如龙 1991 《闽语研究》 (语文出版社) but the sentence carries no inline citation

new_statements.reading: tone language with a stress statement
new_statements.second_reader_evidence: Quote: lines 141-149 (====變調====.. '# 基本原则：两字连读，前变后不变，也没有明显的轻声'.. '# 前字入声的变高平(55)') match the quoted passage character for character; the compiler only joined the wikitext lines with ' # '. Surrounding section (声调 table: 6 tones 52/33/21/54/35/13; 變調 list) says nothing else about prominence; the article has no inline citation for the sentence, only a reference list (周長楫、林寳卿 1992 永安方言; 陈章太、李如龙 1991 闽语研究). Nakajima 1979 checked independently: pp. 21-22 (front-matter (15)-(16)) rendered with page render and read as images — '5. 永安方言の音韻': initials, finals, five tones (陰平53, 陽平33, 陰上21, 陽上55, 去声24; note that 去声 and 陽上 carry glottal stricture) and a tone-sandhi arrow diagram; no mention of stress…
new_statements.rule_in_words: Yong'an (Central Min) is a six-tone language whose disyllabic tone sandhi is right-dominant (the final syllable keeps its citation tone, the non-final syllable changes); the only prominence-related claim is that there is no clear neutral tone, i.e. no lexically reduced/unstressed syllable. No source opened states a word-stress position; nothing in a first-hand description was found.
new_statements.secondary_stress: Not mentioned in any opened source.
new_statements.exceptions: A few qusheng words with historically voiced initials take 55 or shangsheng in non-final position (sandhi, not stress).
new_statements.domain_note: Two-syllable words/compounds in connected reading (两字连读); citation tones are given per syllable. Nakajima 1979 pp. (15)-(16), the only first-hand description opened, gives tones and sandhi for Yong'an and is silent on stress.
new_statements.identity_note: All material is for the Yong'an 永安 variety, the representative dialect of Central Min (minz1235 has no separate Glottolog dialect code for Yong'an; Sanming 三明 and Shaxian 沙县 are the other two varieties). Nakajima 1979's Yong'an data come from a non-native (Fuzhou-born) consultant.

new_statements.quote: [ops/1674.htm, image ] 三、声调(6个、古阳入调归阳上) 调类 ①阴平 ②阳平 ③阴上 ④阳上 ⑤去声 ⑥入声 / 调值 42 33 21 54 24 12 / 例字 虚东 薯同 许董 熟动独 恕栋洞 叔督. [ops/1675.htm 第二节 连续变调, image ] 永安方言两个字连读的时候，第二个字不变调。第一个字除阳平调仍读本调不变，去声调变化比较没规律外，其他各调都要发生变化，变化规则相当严整。 [image ] 二、其他各调（去声调除外）变调表（音标右上角是本调调值，右下角是变调后的调值）: 阴平42 变33 (中秋 tam42/33 ts'iau42 ...); 阴上21 变33 (好心 haɯ21/33 sã42 ...); 阳上54 变21 (调兵 tiɯ54/21 pã33 ..., 独身 tɔu54/21 siã42 ...); 入声12 变55 (腹肌 pu12/55 kye42 ...).
new_statements.translation: III. Tones (6; the old yang-entering tone has merged into yangshang): yinping 42, yangping 33, yinshang 21, yangshang 54, qusheng 24, rusheng 12 (example characters ...). Section 2, Tone sandhi: When two syllables are read together in the Yong'an dialect, the second syllable does not change its tone. As for the first syllable, apart from yangping, which keeps its citation tone, and qusheng, whose changes are rather irregular, all the other tones change, and the rules of change are quite strict. II. Sandhi table for the other tones (qusheng excluded; superscript = citation value, subscript = sandhi value): yinping 42 -> 33; yinshang 21 -> 33; yangshang 54 -> 21; rusheng 12 -> 55 (examples before every one of the six following tones).

new_statements.relation_note: Compatible with the catalog record (classification tonal, Nakajima 1979: 5 tones 陰平53 陽平33 陰上21 陽上55 去声24, sandhi 陰平->陽平33, 陰上->陽平33, 陽上->陰上21, 去声->陽上55) and adds detail from a native-speaker-based description: a sixth tone 入声 12 (古阴入; 古阳入 merged into 阳上), slightly different values (阴平42, 阳上54), 入声->55 sandhi, 去声 sandhi called irregular rather than ->55, and the explicit domain statement '第二个字不变调' (last syllable keeps citation tone). It confirms the '前变后不变' half of the zh.wikipedia statement held by the project but is SILENT on its '也没有明显的轻声' clause (no mention of 轻声/重音 at all), so the neutral-tone/stress remark held by the project still rests on zh.wikipedia (< 周长楫、林宝卿 1992) alone. No cont…
new_statements.rule_in_words: Yong'an is described purely as a tone language: six citation tones (阴平42, 阳平33, 阴上21, 阳上54, 去声24, 入声12) and a right-dominant two-syllable tone sandhi in which the final syllable keeps its citation tone and the first syllable changes (42->33, 21->33, 54->21, 12->55; 阳平 unchanged; 去声 irregular). The chapter has no statement about word stress, 重音 or 轻声; suffixes 子 tsɿ3, 仔 tsã3, 头 t'ø2, 畲 sɔ2 are all transcribed with full tone categories (FY41-FY42), and no neutral-tone syllables are marked anywhere in the vocabulary or text samples.
new_statements.exceptions: 去声 as first syllable 'changes rather irregularly' (去声调变化比较没规律) and is left out of the sandhi table; 阳平 as first syllable keeps its citation tone; sub-dialect differences (市区/岭后/安砂/罗坊 片) are segmental and tonal-category only (FY06-FY07).
new_statements.identity_note: 永安方言 市区片 (Yong'an city speech: 永安市区, 贡川, 曹远, 洪田 etc.), the representative point of Central Min 闽中语; the chapter also tabulates the 岭后, 安砂 and 罗坊 sub-varieties (FY06-FY07) and notes Minnan, Hakka and Fuzhou enclaves inside the municipality. The 方言 chapter is unsigned; the 1992 周长楫、林宝卿 永安方言 monograph was prepared for the same 地方志编委会.

tone_statements.citation: 福建省三明市地方志编纂委员会 (编). 2002. 三明市志. 北京: 方志出版社. ISBN 7-80122-619-4. 卷五十三 方言, 第一章 三元话 (第一节 声韵调系统: 三、声调, 表53-3 三元话声调调类调值表; 第三节 方言词语 headnote), 第二章 三明地区各方言特点比较. Online edition:https://data.fjdsfzw.org.cn/upload/Annals/2011/三明市志/epub/ops/3564.htm.
tone_statements.quote: 三元话有声调6个。 表53-3 三元话声调调类调值表 声调编号 ① ② ③ ④ ⑤ ⑥ 调类 阴平 阳平 阴上 阳上 去声 入声 调值 553 41 21 213 33 12 [...] 注:三元话变调比较简单,而且快说变,慢说不变。鉴于此,志中词汇,只标字音本调。 [...] 三元话多音词连读时非末音节有时要发生变调，慢说时也可以不变调。
tone_statements.translation: Sanyuan has 6 tones. Table 53-3, tone categories and values of Sanyuan: nos. 1-6; categories yinping, yangping, yinshang, yangshang, qusheng, rusheng; values 553, 41, 21, 213, 33, 12 [...] Note: Sanyuan tone sandhi is rather simple, and applies in fast speech but not in slow speech; therefore the vocabulary in this gazetteer is marked with citation tones only. [...] In Sanyuan polysyllabic words non-final syllables sometimes undergo tone sandhi; in slow speech they may also stay unchanged.
tone_statements.summary: 6 tones (553 41 21 213 33 12-short), optional fast-speech sandhi on non-final syllables.

tone_statements.citation: 福建省地方志编纂委员会 (编); 黄典诚 主编, 李如龙 副主编. 1998. 福建省志·方言志. 北京: 方志出版社. 6+662 pp. ISBN 7-80122-279-2. Chapter 5 闽中方言 (printed pp. 241-276; sec. 2 永安音系: 声韵调, 单字音表, 连读变调; sec. 5 内部差异) and ch. 10 声调对照表 (永安, 三明, 沙县 columns). Online edition: 福建党史方志网 志书库,http://data.fjdsfzw.org.cn/upload/Annals/2011/方言志/epub/ops/113.htm(声调) and ops/115.htm (连读变调).
tone_statements.quote: 永安话的声调有6个： 表5-3 永安话声调表 调类 阴平① 阳平② 阴上③ 阳上④ 去声⑤ 入声⑦ 调值 42 33 21 54 24 12 例字 虚东 薯同 许董 熟独动 恕栋洞 叔督 说明： 1.阳上调调值高而短促，阳上调的字，音节末尾似带轻微的喉塞韵尾-?，发音时肌肉略有紧张。 2.入声是低升调，调值并不短促。 [...] (二)永安话的二字组连读变调的特点 1.二字组连读时，一般是后字不变。 2.前字有时变有时不变： 阳平调在任何情况下都不变调； 阴平、阴上在各声调前，一律变为阳平调； 阳上在各声调前，一律变为阴上调； 去声的变化比较复杂。去声在阴上和阳上调前变为阳平调，在阴平、阳平、去声和入声前变化高平调，调值44； 入声在各声调前也一律变为高平调，调值55。
tone_statements.translation: Yong'an has 6 tones: Table 5-3: categories yinping (1), yangping (2), yinshang (3), yangshang (4), qusheng (5), rusheng (7); values 42, 33, 21, 54, 24, 12; example characters ... Notes: 1. The yangshang tone is high and short; its syllables seem to end in a slight glottal stop and are pronounced with some muscular tension. 2. The rusheng is a low rising tone and is not short. [...] (2) Features of disyllabic tone sandhi in Yong'an: 1. the second syllable generally does not change; 2. the first syllable sometimes changes: yangping never changes; yinping and yinshang become yangping before any tone; yangshang becomes yinshang before any tone; qusheng is more complex: it becomes yangping before yinshang and yangshang, and a high level tone 44 before yinping, yangping, qusheng and rusheng; rusheng becomes a high level tone 55 before any tone.
tone_statements.locator: 第五章 闽中方言, 第二节 永安音系, 一、声韵调 (三)声调 with 表5-3 永安话声调表, and 三、连读变调 (二) (online and; chapter pp. 241-276, exact page not marked in the online edition)
tone_statements.summary: 6 tones (42 33 21 54 24 12), syllable TBU, 阳上 short with weak glottal coda, right-dominant disyllabic sandhi with two derived level tones 44/55.

tone_statements.citation: 沙县地方志编纂委员会 (编); 李启宇 主编. 1992. 沙县志. 北京: 中国科学技术出版社. ISBN 7-110-02307-9. 第三十二篇 方言, 第一章 沙县话语音 (第一节 声韵调系统: 三、声调; 第三节 连读变调和文白异读; 第四节 沙县话和普通话语音比较: 三、声调). Online edition:https://data.fjdsfzw.org.cn/upload/Annals/2011/沙县志/epub/ops/1222.htm(声调) and ops/1225.htm (连读变调).
tone_statements.quote: 沙县话有声调6个,其调类和调值如下: 阴平 33 诗衣东夫基箱腰朱 阴上 21 … 阳上 53 是弟动木极象药聚 去声 24 四意洞护记上要蛀 入声 212 失益督福急息约足 [...] 在多音词语中，末音节不变调，在前的音节受后字声调的影响而发生变调。[...] 阴平字在前,不论后字何调均变为44 [...] 阳平字在前，不论后字何调均变为原阴平调33 [...] 阴上字在前,不论后字何调均变为55 [...] 阳上字在前，不论后字何调均变为原阴上调 [...] 去声字在前,后字为阴平、阳平、阴上、入声时变为原阴上调 [...] 后字为阳上、去声时变为44 [...] 入声字在前,不论后字何调均变为4
tone_statements.translation: Shaxian has 6 tones; categories and values: yinping 33 (examples), yinshang 21, yangshang 53, qusheng 24, rusheng 212 [...] In polysyllabic words the final syllable does not change tone; preceding syllables change under the influence of the following tone. [...] yinping first: becomes 44 whatever follows; yangping first: becomes the yinping value 33 whatever follows; yinshang first: becomes 55; yangshang first: becomes the yinshang tone; qusheng first: becomes the yinshang tone before yinping, yangping, yinshang, rusheng, and 44 before yangshang and qusheng; rusheng first: becomes 4 whatever follows.
tone_statements.check: quotation verified in source (minor differences in wording)

sources.quote: 永安话的声调有6个： 表5-3 永安话声调表 调类 阴平① 阳平② 阴上③ 阳上④ 去声⑤ 入声⑦ 调值 42 33 21 54 24 12 例字 虚东 薯同 许董 熟独动 恕栋洞 叔督 说明： 1.阳上调调值高而短促，阳上调的字，音节末尾似带轻微的喉塞韵尾-?，发音时肌肉略有紧张。 2.入声是低升调，调值并不短促。 [...] (二)永安话的二字组连读变调的特点 1.二字组连读时，一般是后字不变。 2.前字有时变有时不变： 阳平调在任何情况下都不变调； 阴平、阴上在各声调前，一律变为阳平调； 阳上在各声调前，一律变为阴上调； 去声的变化比较复杂。去声在阴上和阳上调前变为阳平调，在阴平、阳平、去声和入声前变化高平调，调值44； 入声在各声调前也一律变为高平调，调值55。
sources.locator: 第五章 闽中方言, 第二节 永安音系, 一、声韵调 (三)声调 with 表5-3 永安话声调表, and 三、连读变调 (二) (online and; chapter pp. 241-276, exact page not marked in the online edition)
sources.note: Yong'an has 6 citation tones: 阴平 42, 阳平 33, 阴上 21, 阳上 54 (high, short, slight glottal-stop coda, tense), 去声 24, 入声 12 (low rising, not short). Disyllabic tone sandhi is right-dominant: final syllable keeps citation tone; 阳平 never changes; 阴平 and 阴上 -> 阳平 33; 阳上 -> 阴上 21; 去声 -> 阳平 before 阴上/阳上, -> new high level 44 before 阴平/阳平/去声/入声; 入声 -> new high level 55. Sec. 5: 永安/三明/沙县 differ mainly in tone values, not categories. Differs from the Nakajima 1979 statement listed here (5 tones, 阴平 53, 阳上 55, no separate 入声) in counting 入声 12 as a sixth tone; the sandhi mapping agrees.

tone.translation: Yong'an has 6 tones: Table 5-3: categories yinping (1), yangping (2), yinshang (3), yangshang (4), qusheng (5), rusheng (7); values 42, 33, 21, 54, 24, 12; example characters ... Notes: 1. The yangshang tone is high and short; its syllables seem to end in a slight glottal stop and are pronounced with some muscular tension. 2. The rusheng is a low rising tone and is not short. [...] (2) Features of disyllabic tone sandhi in Yong'an: 1. the second syllable generally does not change; 2. the first syllable sometimes changes: yangping never changes; yinping and yinshang become yangping before any tone; yangshang becomes yinshang before any tone; qusheng is more complex: it becomes yangping before yinshang and yangshang, and a high level tone 44 before yinping, yangping, qusheng and rusheng; rusheng becomes a high level tone 55 before any tone.
tone.summary: 6 tones (42 33 21 54 24 12), syllable TBU, 阳上 short with weak glottal coda, right-dominant disyllabic sandhi with two derived level tones 44/55.

sources.citation: 沙县地方志编纂委员会 (编); 李启宇 主编. 1992. 沙县志. 北京: 中国科学技术出版社. ISBN 7-110-02307-9. 第三十二篇 方言, 第一章 沙县话语音 (第一节 声韵调系统: 三、声调; 第三节 连读变调和文白异读; 第四节 沙县话和普通话语音比较: 三、声调). Online edition:https://data.fjdsfzw.org.cn/upload/Annals/2011/沙县志/epub/ops/1222.htm(声调) and ops/1225.htm (连读变调).
sources.quote: 沙县话有声调6个,其调类和调值如下: 阴平 33 诗衣东夫基箱腰朱 阴上 21 … 阳上 53 是弟动木极象药聚 去声 24 四意洞护记上要蛀 入声 212 失益督福急息约足 [...] 在多音词语中，末音节不变调，在前的音节受后字声调的影响而发生变调。[...] 阴平字在前,不论后字何调均变为44 [...] 阳平字在前，不论后字何调均变为原阴平调33 [...] 阴上字在前,不论后字何调均变为55 [...] 阳上字在前，不论后字何调均变为原阴上调 [...] 去声字在前,后字为阴平、阳平、阴上、入声时变为原阴上调 [...] 后字为阳上、去声时变为44 [...] 入声字在前,不论后字何调均变为4
sources.note: Shaxian (城关) has 6 tones: 阴平 33, 阳平 31, 阴上 21, 阳上 53, 去声 24, 入声 212. The sec. 1 tone table image omits the 阳平 row, but the sec. 4 comparison table 沙县音/北京音 (ops/1230.htm, image) lists all six: 阴平33, 阳平31, 阴上21, 阳上53, 去声24, 入声212. Polysyllabic sandhi (ops/1225.htm): final syllable keeps its tone; non-final syllables change by their own category (trisyllables: first two syllables follow the disyllabic rules): 阴平 33 -> 44; 阳平 31 -> 33 (= citation 阴平); 阴上 21 -> 55; 阳上 53 -> 21 (= citation 阴上); 去声 24 -> 21 before 阴平/阳平/阴上/入声, -> 44 before 阳上/去声; 入声 212 -> short 4.

tone.translation: Shaxian has 6 tones; categories and values: yinping 33 (examples), yinshang 21, yangshang 53, qusheng 24, rusheng 212 [...] In polysyllabic words the final syllable does not change tone; preceding syllables change under the influence of the following tone. [...] yinping first: becomes 44 whatever follows; yangping first: becomes the yinping value 33 whatever follows; yinshang first: becomes 55; yangshang first: becomes the yinshang tone; qusheng first: becomes the yinshang tone before yinping, yangping, yinshang, rusheng, and 44 before yangshang and qusheng; rusheng first: becomes 4 whatever follows.
